response.overview: Andru Suárez is a visual artist from the Colombian Caribbean who combines in his work such disparate elements as Gothic architecture, Victorian aesthetics, cross-dressing, surrealism, and Taylor Swift's music catalogue. This documentary is a journey through the work and life of this artist through the process of creating one of his watercolors, from the initial sketch to the last brushstroke. With each line and each drop of color, Andru tells us about his life, his vision of the world and his own reflections on identity, gender and acceptance.
response.title: Andru
